程序包 org.bukkit.scoreboard

接口 Objective

public interface Objective
An objective on a scoreboard that can show scores specific to entries. This objective is only relevant to the display of the associated scoreboard. 记分板上的一个目标（objective），可以显示特定条目的分数。此目标仅与关联的 记分板的显示相关。
